topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I stumbled upon a social media post today, and there it was—my design, the one I poured my heart into, etched into someone’s skin. The ink was bold, the lines were perfect, and it was unmistakably mine. Yet, I wasn’t the one who decided it should be there. I should feel honored, right? After all, it means my work resonates with people. But the thought of having no control over how my art is used leaves me tangled up inside. Maybe I should reach out, or maybe it’s better left unsaid. Either way, I can’t shake this heaviness in my chest.
